lazy_chunks.option.enabled.name: Lazy Chunk Loading
lazy_chunks.option.enabled.tooltip: Spreads chunk task processing across multiple frames to reduce visible stutter.
lazy_chunks.option.debug_overlay.name: F3 Debug Info
lazy_chunks.option.debug_overlay.tooltip: Shows LazyChunks status lines in the F3 debug overlay.
lazy_chunks.option.target_fps.name: Target FPS
lazy_chunks.option.target_fps.tooltip: Baseline FPS used for chunk budget calculation.
lazy_chunks.option.fps_threshold.name: FPS Threshold
lazy_chunks.option.fps_threshold.tooltip: When FPS is above this value, chunk processing can run at vanilla speed.
Reduces chunk processing when frame times become unstable.
lazy_chunks.option.teleport_protection.t: Uses extra conservative throttling after teleporting or changing dimensions.
lazy_chunks.option.base_weight.name: Base Weight
lazy_chunks.option.base_weight.tooltip: Chunk task weight budget processed per frame at the target FPS.
lazy_chunks.option.max_frame_time.name: Max Frame Time
lazy_chunks.option.max_frame_time.toolti: Maximum percent of a frame that LazyChunks may spend on chunk processing.
lazy_chunks.option.minimum_budget.name: Minimum Budget
lazy_chunks.option.minimum_budget.toolti: Minimum chunk task budget kept available to prevent loading stalls.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_core_boost.to: Adds virtual throttling cores when 1% low FPS is poor but average FPS has headroom.
lazy_chunks.option.low_threshold.name: 1% Low Threshold
lazy_chunks.option.low_threshold.tooltip: 1% low FPS threshold used by dynamic core boost detection.
lazy_chunks.option.low_duration.name: Low Duration
lazy_chunks.option.low_duration.tooltip: How long 1% low FPS must stay below the threshold before extra cores are considered.
lazy_chunks.option.average_fps_threshold: Average FPS must be above this value before dynamic extra cores are added.
lazy_chunks.option.fps_per_core.name: FPS Per Core
lazy_chunks.option.fps_per_core.tooltip: Additional average FPS required for each extra virtual core.
lazy_chunks.option.max_extra_cores.name: Max Extra Cores
lazy_chunks.option.max_extra_cores.toolt: Maximum number of extra virtual throttling cores.
lazy_chunks.option.core_increase_step.to: How many extra virtual cores can be added per check.
lazy_chunks.option.core_decrease_step.to: How many extra virtual cores can be removed per check.
lazy_chunks.option.weight_per_core.name: Weight Per Core
lazy_chunks.option.weight_per_core.toolt: Extra chunk task weight budget provided by each virtual core.
